explication: Apache Texera is a visual, AI-assisted data-science workflow platform. The principal flow is: an analyst designs a workflow in the GUI or describes it to an agent; execution is coordinated into scheduled parallel worker activity; operators process tuples and materialize results; statistics and debugging state are returned for refinement. The graph also shows the sampled worker metrics path and the platform’s storage/versioning integrations. Several backend API and collaboration routes are represented only at directory-level architectural scope because their implementations were not sampled.
